title: Routed campus ticket: static route beats OSPF
summary: Remove a conflicting static route so the equally specific OSPF route can forward traffic.
brief: EDGE-A has both a static and OSPF route for the exact SITE-B prefix, 10.20.20.0/24. The static route has an invalid next hop, so traffic fails despite the healthy OSPF route. Inspect the route table, apply source-preference reasoning after the prefix-length tie, and remove only the conflicting static route.
objectives: Identify the equal-prefix static and OSPF routes
Explain why static is selected on a prefix-length tie
Remove the bad static route and verify host reachability
hints: Longest prefix does not choose between identical prefixes.
For the same prefix, route source preference determines the selected route.
Do not remove the OSPF network statement.
